name: Should I hire one company for cleanup and repairs, or separate vendors for a foreclosed property?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire one company for cleanup and repairs, or separate vendors for a foreclosed property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compare crews on scope clarity, response time, documentation quality, and whether they handle both cleanup and repairs. In Denver-area foreclosures, it is especially useful to choose a team that can assess basement moisture, winter-related damage, and mixed-condition interiors without needing multiple handoffs.
acceptedAnswer.description: One team is often easier if they can handle both cleanup and repairs. That reduces handoffs, speeds up the job, and makes the scope easier to manage.
